name: Literatus
description: Scholarly covenant of the Roman Tribunal whose magi must always keep an apprentice and take mundane pupils in Bologna; long an opponent of Magvillus at Tribunal.

name: Covenant of Harco
description: Roman Tribunal covenant deeply involved in mundane and mercantile affairs, held up by Transitionalists as an example of magi and mundanes interacting well.

name: Luctatio
description: Spring covenant of competitive Tytalus founded 1172 in Lombardy, with holdings in Milan, Pavia and Venice, playing a manipulative game with those cities and the Tribunal.

name: Magvillus
description: Domus Magnus of House Quaesitor in the mountains of the Kingdom of Sicily, founded A.D. 830; heart of Hermetic law, riven between Traditionalists and Transitionalists.

name: Postestas
description: Summer Tremere covenant founded 870, a fortress on Italy's east coast overlooking the Adriatic, secretly plotting to seize the Roman Tribunal for House Tremere.

name: Rellantali
description: Autumn covenant founded 838 on the island of Asinara, nearly destroyed by Verdi; its magi now live in Venice and secretly run the city's thieves.

name: Sansaron
description: Reclusive covenant founded 951 in carved passages under the ruins of Carthage, studying ancient Carthaginian magic and selling items to mundanes of Tunis.

name: Vardian's Tomb
description: Unrecognized covenant in a forgotten catacomb south of Rome near the Tiber, fractured between Jerbiton founders and Ex Miscellanea necromancers.

name: Verdi
description: Domus Magnus of House Verditius, founded A.D. 775 in a hidden valley in Sardinia's eastern mountains; a great, bullying power of the Roman Tribunal devoted to magical invention.

name: Auctus
description: Former Sardinian covenant founded by a Bonisagus, a Criamon and a Merinita to unite Enigmatic, Faerie and Hermetic magic; destroyed by Verdi in 937.

name: Al Arama
description: Covenant in the Levant that trades raw vis for silver and magic items with Rellantali and Verdi.

name: Feritel
description: Unrecognized independent covenant founded 1117, officially a subject commune of Genoa, whose magi live as nobility and aid the Genoese.

name: Traditionalists
description: Quaesitores holding conservative, strict interpretations of Hermetic Law; at Magvillus led by Arliandus.

name: Transitionalists
description: Quaesitores with liberal views who want the Code reinterpreted for changing times; at Magvillus led by Ferilan.

name: Independent Magi
description: Magi and wizards in the Roman Tribunal outside recognized covenants, either naturalistic or living among mundanes, keeping quiet to avoid Hermetic prosecution.

name: Hopolites
description: A group of warrior magi, many of them Flambeau Arch-Magi, who enforce the rulings of the Quaesitores.

name: The Seven of Magvillus
description: The seven full Quaesitor members of Magvillus, chief administrators of their House, sworn to secrecy about the private library.

name: Arch-Magi
description: The conclave of the Order's most powerful magi who meet secretly, support Magvillus, and maintain the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi whose laws Magvillus enforces.

name: Thieves of Venice
description: Network of Venetian thieves united by Renser of Tremere and controlled by Rellantali, some of whom are secretly Infernal agents.

name: Seelie Court
description: Faeries of the Last Italian Faerie Forest, led by Shen, who protect the wood through trickery.

name: Silver Fangs
description: A pack of seven werewolves led by Antonio who violently protect the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Older magical tradition in which some of Italy's independent wild-land wizards have their roots.

name: Druids
description: Magical tradition whose magic Bonisagus combined into his theory.

name: The Seekers
description: Group who preach that beings like Poseidon may be Old Ones.

name: Shadow Senate
description: Six Roman senators who pacted with Hell and returned in 476 as undead revenants, secretly trying to rule Rome from their tomb.

name: Necromancers of Vardian's Tomb
description: Ex Miscellanea magi invited into Vardian's Tomb who proved to be necromancers, in conflict with the Jerbiton founders.

name: Papacy
description: The Pope and Church in Rome, whose attention Roman magi fear drawing.

name: Saracens
description: Arab invaders of Sardinia and Italy's western islands in the 9th century; many Verdi covenfolk descend from them.

name: Council of Pavia
description: City council of Pavia on which Erimas of Luctatio sits.

name: House Quaesitor
description: The House (House Guernicus) responsible for enforcing the Code; its Domus Magnus is Magvillus.

name: House Verditius
description: House of magical inventors whose Domus Magnus is Verdi.

name: House Tytalus
description: House of competitive, manipulative magi prominent in Luctatio and Rellantali.

name: House Flambeau
description: House of warlike magi; many Hopolites are Flambeau.

name: House Tremere
description: House of Postestas, which plots to put Rome in Tremere hands.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House whose magi founded Vardian's Tomb and Feritel.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House of Bonisagus; Rellantali's founders sought its inventors.

name: House Criamon
description: House of a founder of Auctus and members of Sansaron and Vardian's Tomb.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-magic House; Silva Ambages is a Merinita.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House of assorted traditions; members at Sansaron and Vardian's Tomb.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House of Samnium of Sansaron.

name: House Mercere
description: House of messengers, not required to visit unrecognized covenants like Feritel.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: The Tribunal of Italy, torn by politics, vis shortage and mercantilism.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal whose decisions form part of the Code.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Distant Tribunal reached by the Half-Glade in winter.

name: Amberitus
description: Magus of Literatus who holds the Arch-Mage title and may demand tasks for information.

name: Arliandus
description: Primus of House Quaesitor, leader of Magvillus and of its Traditionalists; aged 139, reputed just; guardian of the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi.

name: Denique of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Transitionalist.

name: Dione of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Exquiro of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Friuli of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Transitionalist.

name: Protantus of Quaesitor
description: Listed full member of Magvillus.

name: Procella of Quaesitor
description: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

name: Ferilan
description: Transitionalist leader at Magvillus and one of the foremost Transitionalists in the Order; former master of Adria.

name: Adria of Quaesitor
description: Associate member of Magvillus and former apprentice of Ferilan, whom Traditionalists want sent away.

name: Largen of Quaesitor
description: Associate Quaesitor member of Magvillus who avoids its politics.

name: Monferrato of Quaesitor
description: Associate Quaesitor member of Magvillus who avoids its politics.

name: Morum of Tytalus
description: Arabic Tytalus serving Magvillus as an enforcing associate member; bitter enemy of Verox.

name: Verox of Flambeau
description: Iberian Flambeau associate member of Magvillus who hunts hedge wizards and magical creatures; reputed an executioner.

name: Simprim of Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor who delivered a Transitionalist speech to the Seven of Magvillus.

name: Guernicus
description: Founder of House Quaesitor, whose bounds on Quaesitor power are debated; Magvillus was founded after his death.

name: Mercatora
description: Tytalus leader of Rellantali, aged 71, greedy, ruthless and prone to fury.

name: Artur of Jerbiton
description: Rellantali magus who maintains relations with Venice.

name: Dareth of Tytalus
description: 63-year-old Rellantali magus jealous of Evoco, considering plotting with Verdi.

name: Evoco of Tremere
description: Mercatora's second-in-command and lover at Rellantali.

name: Idus of Flambeau
description: Rellantali magus who stays at the Asinaran fortress, used for quick violent action.

name: Marius of Tremere
description: Rellantali magus who works closely with the thieves the covenant controls.

name: Renser of Tremere
description: Rellantali Tremere who united the thieves of Venice under his authority.

name: Verditius
description: Founder of House Verditius who studied with Bonisagus and built the hut that became Verdi in Sardinia.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder whose theory combined the magic of Mercurians and Druids; taught Verditius.

name: Imanitosi
description: Primus of House Verditius and leader of Verdi, aged 132, who has enchanted some two score magic items.

name: Astuth
description: Verditius full member of Verdi, aged 93.

name: Ferramentum
description: Verditius full member of Verdi, aged 101.

name: Marcelo
description: Verdi experimenter investing foreign magical traditions into his items.

name: Retistius
description: Verdi magus who won the 1181 Verditius contest with a mechanical dog.

name: Steris
description: Youngest full member and spokesman of Verdi, aged 54, who investigates rumors and lost items.

name: Aratol
description: Apprentice at Verdi who created the Potent Pot of Tasty Tea.

name: Gabricon
description: Maker of Gabricon's Doormat of Welcoming.

name: Geran
description: Verdi magus who made Geran's Iron Pick for the covenant's mine.

name: Nerius
description: Rumored Pious Magus said to have destroyed an Infernal talisman at Verdi and blessed Verdi Light.

name: Himinis the Mad
description: Long-dead Verdi magus who left behind many cursed devices.

name: Ubertino of Verditius
description: Verditius who made the three swords Faith, Love and Truth.

name: Anguis
description: Verditius rumored to have learned magic from the dragon Siguson.

name: Maren
description: Verditius who made great weapons for kings before the Treaty.

name: Erimas of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Pavia.

name: Flaren of Flambeau
description: Luctatio magus aiding Erimas in Pavia.

name: Mario of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Milan.

name: Notatio of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus aiding Erimas in Pavia.

name: Paul of Jerbiton
description: Luctatio magus on the Council of Milan.

name: Turati of Tytalus
description: Luctatio magus who sets the rules of the covenant's game between Milan and Pavia.

name: Garvil
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Davan
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Karantia
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Tiana
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Tolas
description: Tremere member of Postestas.

name: Narisian
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Sansaron.

name: Barontel
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Sansaron.

name: Samnium of Bjornaer
description: Member of Sansaron.

name: Talon of Criamon
description: Member of Sansaron.

name: Fortunatus of Jerbiton
description: Member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Luke of Jerbiton
description: Member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Meles of Criamon
description: Member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Rubaton
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Tarith
description: Ex Miscellanea member of Vardian's Tomb.

name: Anson of Jerbiton
description: Member of Feritel (called Anson of Sansaron elsewhere) once trapped five years in the Faerie forest.

name: Herzak of Verditius
description: Member of Feritel.

name: Ranitel of Jerbiton
description: Member of Feritel.

name: Flambeau
description: Founder of House Flambeau whose legendary hunt for heretics still haunts independents.

name: Ulysses
description: Greek hero who blinded Polyphemus on Sicily's east coast returning from Troy.

name: Poseidon
description: Said father of the Cyclopes of Sicily, whose power watches over Polyphemus.

name: Homer
description: Author of The Odyssey, quoted on the Cyclopes.

name: Agatuzzo
description: Leader of the Shadow Senate, proud and arrogant, under whose house the senators were entombed.

name: Antonio (Shadow Senator)
description: Shadow Senator worried about his fate who may seek salvation.

name: Francisco
description: Cowardly Shadow Senator.

name: Mario (Shadow Senator)
description: Slow-witted Shadow Senator.

name: Bernoni
description: Shadow Senator doubting the Senate's leadership.

name: Giuseppe
description: Bored Shadow Senator who may cause havoc in Rome.

name: Pietro
description: Rich Roman merchant whose family serves the Shadow Senate and whose house hides the tomb entrance.

name: Pope Innocent III
description: Pope whose ascension is traced to the Shadow Senate.

name: Silva Ambages
description: Independent Merinita magus, protector and healer of the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Shen
description: Trickster faerie leader of the Seelie Court in the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Antonio (werewolf)
description: Old warrior leader of the Silver Fangs werewolves, able to sense corruption.

name: Crantel
description: Criamon who proposed the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi at their first meeting.

name: Tarus of Bonisagus
description: Author of Politics of the Order, musing on the Arch-Magi.

name: Polyphemus
description: Last Cyclops of Sicily, nearly 50 feet tall and blinded by Ulysses, now lonely; Magic Might 40.

name: Cyclopes
description: Giant one-eyed race of eastern Sicily who departed centuries ago, leaving Polyphemus.

name: Siguson
description: Great dragon from whom Anguis reputedly learned magic.

name: Revenants
description: Undead forms of the Shadow Senators; Infernal Might 20.

name: Werewolves
description: Shapechangers of the Silver Fangs protecting the Faerie forest.

name: Satyrs
description: Faerie denizens of the Last Italian Faerie Forest who dance at the Dancing Place.

name: Nymphs
description: Faerie denizens of the forest.

name: Fauns
description: Faerie denizens of the forest.

name: Elves
description: Denizens of the Faerie forest.

name: Sprites
description: Denizens of the Faerie forest.

name: Imps
description: Denizens of the Faerie forest.

name: Demons
description: Infernal beings; summoned in the Shadow Senate's shrine and found in the forest's dark places.

name: Ogres
description: Creatures found in the Faerie forest's dark places.

name: Drakes
description: Creatures found in dark places.

name: Wyrms
description: Creatures found in dark places.

name: Dragon
description: Great serpents; a dragon might threaten the Faerie forest.

name: Skeletons and Zombies
description: Undead guardians raised in the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi from past violators.

name: Gryphon
description: Creature whose eye might restore Polyphemus' sight.

name: Mechanical Animals of Verdi
description: Enchanted mechanical animals in Verdi's woods that warn grogs of intruders.

name: Bologna
description: City where Literatus magi take mundane apprentices.

name: Sicily
description: Island and Kingdom of Sicily, home of Magvillus, Polyphemus and much of the Faerie forest; officially owned by Magvillus.

name: Asinara
description: Small island north of Sardinia, site of Rellantali's nearly abandoned fortress.

name: Venice
description: Neutral trading city where Rellantali's magi live and Verdi has a townhouse.

name: Sardinia
description: Island claimed almost wholly by Verdi, dotted with Nuraghi.

name: Corsica
description: Island claimed by Verdi and touched by the Faerie forest.

name: Levant
description: Eastern region of Al Arama, trading partner of Roman covenants.

name: Tyrrhenian Sea
description: Sea into which Verdi's stream eventually flows.

name: Verdi's Tower
description: Tower raised by Conjuring the Mystic Tower where Verditius' hut stood; dwelling of the Primus, full of enchantments.

name: Milan
description: Lombard city manipulated by Luctatio.

name: Pavia
description: Lombard city manipulated by Luctatio.

name: Lombardy
description: Region where Luctatio is located.

name: Adriatic Sea
description: Sea overlooked by Postestas.

name: Carthage
description: Ruined ancient city beneath which Sansaron lies.

name: Tunis
description: North African city whose mundanes buy Sansaron's items.

name: North Africa
description: Region of Sansaron.

name: Rome
description: City under which lie catacombs, Vardian's Tomb and the Shadow Senate.

name: Tiber
description: River near which Vardian's Tomb lies.

name: Genoa
description: City of which Feritel is a subject commune.

name: Pisa
description: City that fought to reclaim Sardinia from the Saracens.

name: Mount Etna
description: Sicilian mountain southeast of which Polyphemus dwells.

name: Troy
description: City destroyed by the Greeks in the war before Ulysses' voyage.

name: Apennine Mountains
description: Italian mountains hiding mythic places and the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi.

name: Realm of Polyphemus
description: Fog-shrouded devastated lands of eastern Sicily where Polyphemus lives.

name: Cave of Polyphemus
description: Foul cave atop a cliff, closed by a huge door stone, home of Polyphemus.

name: Tomb of the Shadow Senate
description: Hidden tomb beneath Pietro's house with an Infernal Aura and an unholy shrine.

name: Last Italian Faerie Forest
description: The last great Faerie forest of the Roman Tribunal, mainly on Sicily, with shifting borders and many regiones.

name: The Half-Glade
description: Half circle of nine trees in the Faerie forest serving as a seasonal portal to far Faerie places.

name: The Werewolves' Glen
description: Glen at the forest's center with a Faerie Aura of five and a great evergreen holding Herbam vis.

name: The Dancing Place
description: Grass circle with Faerie Aura four where faeries dance each spring equinox and may answer a question.

name: The Dark Places
description: Places of ancient evil within the Faerie forest, locked away by Shen.

name: Graveyard of the Arch-Magi
description: Hidden tomb in the Apennines, Magic Aura six, where Arch-Magi are interred, protected by Magvillus.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie realm to which the forest may hold an entrance.

name: Nuraghi
description: Ancient conical dry-stone structures of Sardinia that yield raw vis to Verdi.

name: Hibernia
description: Land reached through the Half-Glade in autumn.

name: Italy
description: The peninsula of the Roman Tribunal where magic is in decline.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The world of the setting, shown on Verdi's tapestry.

name: Catacombs of Rome
description: Passages among early Christian tombs beneath Rome, one of which houses Vardian's Tomb.

name: Hermes Portal
description: Magical gate; Rellantali's links Venice and Asinara, and Verdi's links its tower to its Venice townhouse.

name: The Potent Pot of Tasty Tea
description: Brass tea pot by Aratol that pours intoxicating seasoned tea.

name: Gabricon's Doormat of Welcoming
description: Enchanted doormat that senses and announces a visitor's name, and would reveal a demon's True Name.

name: Geran's Iron Pick
description: Lesser enchanted mining pick that destroys plain stone.

name: Verdi Light
description: Everburning torch in Verdi's main hall, said to result from Nerius' blessing.

name: Warding Sword
description: Powerful enchanted sword held by the head of Verdi's turb.

name: Tapestry of Mythic Europe
description: Huge tapestry in Verdi's tower that tracks a person via an Arcane Connection and Imágonem vis.

name: Faith, Love and Truth
description: Three swords by Ubertino of Verditius, each designed to inspire an emotion.

name: Retistius' Mechanical Dog
description: Mechanical dog that won the 1181 Verditius contest.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Potion that reduces aging rolls, used by many magi.

name: Scrying Device of Magvillus
description: Rumored ancient device able to spy through the most powerful wards and Aegis spells.

name: Ring of Lead
description: Lead ring around the Graveyard's entrance invested with warding spells and The Ring of Terror.

name: Enchanted Anchor of Verdi
description: Iron anchor keeping Verdi's lake clean and fresh.

name: Infernal Talisman
description: Talisman at Verdi destroyed by Nerius.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Rego Vim ritual protecting covenants from magical attack.

description: InAq 25 spell known by Arliandus.

description: Rego Córporem 25 spell raising the graveyard's undead guardians.

name: Magic
description: Realm of magic whose auras in Italy have faded over centuries.

name: Divine
description: Realm of God; its Dominion aura pervades cities like Venice and Rome's catacombs.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of Hell; the Shadow Senate's tomb bears Infernal Aura, and Rellantali unwittingly deals with its agents.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of the Fay, strong in the Last Italian Faerie Forest.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The body of Hermetic law enforced by Quaesitores.

name: Treaty of the Roman Tribunal
description: 1068 ruling restricting Roman covenants' trade with mundanes, which nearly destroyed Rellantali.

name: Domus Magnus
description: The chief covenant of a House, e.g. Magvillus and Verdi.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House.

name: Wizard's War
description: Sanctioned conflict between magi.

name: Twilight
description: Magical state; magi track Twilight Points and effects.

name: Wizard's Sigil
description: Characteristic mark of a magus' spells.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power, scarce in the Roman Tribunal; measured in pawns and rooks.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural rating of a place (Magic, Dominion, Divine, Infernal, Faerie).

name: Associate Member
description: Status at Magvillus granting quarters and labs in return for vis and service.

name: Verditius Contest
description: Great contest where Verditius magi compare creations at Verdi; held 1181, 1199, 1217.

name: Form and Effect Bonuses
description: Enchantment bonuses from materials, e.g. Sardinian woods studied by Verdi.

name: Spell Foci
description: Items Verditius need to cast Formulaic spells.

name: Formulaic Spells
description: Standard learned Hermetic spells.

name: Ritual
description: Powerful ceremonial magic.

name: Waiting Spells
description: Spells embodying Imágonem rituals on the graveyard path.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link to a person enabling magic such as Verdi's tapestry.

name: Lab Notes
description: Laboratory records; Verdi holds 400 years of them.

name: Regio
description: Supernatural sub-regions within the Faerie forest.

name: Covenant Season
description: Life stage of a covenant (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter).

name: True Name
description: Name of a demon revealed by Gabricon's doormat.

name: Magic Might
description: Measure of a magical creature's power.

name: Infernal Might
description: Measure of an infernal creature's power.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to magic; also Natural Resistance for non-magi.

name: Pious Magus
description: A magus of true faith, as Nerius is rumored.

name: Diabolism
description: Infernal worship; diabolists are hunted by Magvillus.

name: Necromancy
description: Magic of the dead practiced at Vardian's Tomb.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: Magic of the Order formed by Bonisagus.

name: Enigmatic Magic
description: Criamon magic Auctus sought to integrate.

name: Carthaginian Magic
description: Ancient magic studied at Sansaron, more personal and possibly beyond Hermetic bounds.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent; many Harco members lack it.

name: Old Ones
description: Ancient beings the Seekers claim gods like Poseidon were.

name: Turb
description: Body of a covenant's grogs.

name: Longevity
description: Aging reduction via potions.

name: Mythic Places
description: Rare remaining magical and mysterious sites in Italy.

name: Hermetic Prosecution
description: Legal pursuit of wizards under Hermetic law.

name: Valor Passion
description: Passion usable in place of Brave against The Ring of Terror.

name: Magus
description: Hermetic wizard.

name: Grogs
description: Covenant soldiers and servants.

name: Companions
description: Important non-magus characters.

name: Covenfolk
description: Covenant servants and residents.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator and judge.

name: Apprentice
description: Magus in training.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of the Order.

name: Hedge Wizards
description: Wizards outside the Order.

name: Autocrat
description: Runs day-to-day covenant business.

name: Overseer
description: Manages Literatus' fief.

name: Grog Captain
description: Leader of grogs.

name: Steward
description: Covenfolk manager.

name: Merchant's Associate
description: Rellantali's Master Thief.

name: Custos
description: Covenant guard or grog.
